question: 立项开始日期在 2025 年、项目状态不是规划中的项目，按客户汇总合同金额和项目回款的已到账金额，只要合同金额大于已到账金额。需要返回客户编码、合同金额、已到账金额。
expect_sql: SELECT c.customer_code, SUM(p.contract_amount) AS contract_amt, COALESCE(SUM(rv.received_amt), 0) AS received_amt FROM company.prj_project p JOIN company.crm_customer c ON c.id = p.customer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(received_amount) AS received_amt FROM company.prj_project_revenue GROUP BY project_id ) rv ON rv.project_id = p.id WHERE p.start_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND p.start_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND p.status <> 'planning' GROUP BY c.customer_code HAVING SUM(p.contract_amount) > COALESCE(SUM(rv.received_amt), 0) ORDER BY contract_amt DESC, c.customer_code

question: 报销申请日期在 2025 年、报销状态是已付款、费用类别是差旅的报销明细，按部门加总金额，只要高于各部门这笔差旅合计的平均。需要返回部门编码、差旅金额。
expect_sql: SELECT d.dept_code, SUM(i.amount) AS travel_amt FROM company.fin_reimburse r JOIN company.fin_reimburse_item i ON i.claim_id = r.id JOIN company.org_department d ON d.id = r.dept_id WHERE r.status = 'paid' AND i.category = 'travel' AND r.claim_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND r.claim_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY d.dept_code HAVING SUM(i.amount) > ( SELECT AVG(x.amt) FROM ( SELECT SUM(i2.amount) AS amt FROM company.fin_reimburse r2 JOIN company.fin_reimburse_item i2 ON i2.claim_id = r2.id WHERE r2.status = 'paid' AND i2.category = 'travel' AND r2.claim_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND r2.claim_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r2.dept_id ) x ) ORDER BY travel_amt DESC, d.dept_code

question: 离职日期为空的员工里，加班日期在 2025 年、加班审批状态是已通过的加班小时，高于自己部门里离职日期同样为空的同事的平均加班小时。需要返回工号、部门编码、加班小时。
expect_sql: SELECT e.emp_no, d.dept_code, SUM(o.hours) AS ot_hours FROM company.att_overtime o JOIN company.hr_employee e ON e.id = o.emp_id JOIN company.org_department d ON d.id = e.dept_id WHERE o.status = 'approved' AND o.overtime_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.overtime_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND e.leave_date IS NULL GROUP BY e.emp_no, d.dept_code, d.id HAVING SUM(o.hours) > ( SELECT AVG(x.emp_hours) FROM ( SELECT SUM(o2.hours) AS emp_hours FROM company.att_overtime o2 JOIN company.hr_employee e2 ON e2.id = o2.emp_id WHERE e2.dept_id = d.id AND o2.status = 'approved' AND o2.overtime_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o2.overtime_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND e2.leave_date IS NULL GROUP BY e2.id ) x ) ORDER BY ot_hours DESC, e.emp_no

question: 下单日期在 2025 年、订单状态是已签约、交付中或已关闭的订单，按客户加总订单金额后，已经超过该客户项目回款累计已到账金额的，列出来。需要返回客户编码、订单金额、已到账金额。
expect_sql: SELECT c.customer_code, o.order_amt, COALESCE(rv.received_amt, 0) AS received_amt FROM company.crm_customer c JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, SUM(total_amount) AS order_amt FROM company.sal_sales_order WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'draft') AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY customer_id ) o ON o.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.customer_id, SUM(r.received_amount) AS received_amt FROM company.prj_project p JOIN company.prj_project_revenue r ON r.project_id = p.id GROUP BY p.customer_id ) rv ON rv.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.order_amt > COALESCE(rv.received_amt, 0) ORDER BY o.order_amt DESC, c.customer_code

question: 下单日期在 2025 年、订单状态是已签约、交付中或已关闭的订单里，只算成本类型是云资源成本的产品，按产品线汇总订单行金额。需要返回产品线、金额。
expect_sql: SELECT p.product_line, SUM(i.amount) AS amt FROM company.sal_sales_order_item i JOIN company.sal_sales_order o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN company.prd_product p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'draft') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company.prd_product_cost c WHERE c.product_id = p.id AND c.cost_type = 'cloud' ) GROUP BY p.product_line ORDER BY amt DESC, p.product_line

question: 填报日期在 2025 年、工时审批状态是已通过的工时，只算项目成员离职日期为空的人，并且这个人在该项目上的工时高于该项目其他人的平均。需要返回项目编号、工号、工时。
expect_sql: SELECT p.project_code, e.emp_no, SUM(t.hours) AS hours FROM company.att_timesheet t JOIN company.prj_project p ON p.id = t.project_id JOIN company.hr_employee e ON e.id = t.emp_id WHERE t.status = 'approved' AND t.work_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.work_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company.prj_project_member m WHERE m.project_id = p.id AND m.emp_id = e.id AND m.leave_date IS NULL ) GROUP BY p.project_code, e.emp_no, p.id HAVING SUM(t.hours) > ( SELECT AVG(x.h) FROM ( SELECT SUM(t2.hours) AS h FROM company.att_timesheet t2 WHERE t2.project_id = p.id AND t2.status = 'approved' AND t2.work_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t2.work_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY t2.emp_id ) x ) ORDER BY hours DESC, p.project_code, e.emp_no

question: 请假开始时间在 2025 年、请假审批状态是已通过、请假类型是否带薪为否的请假，按部门合计天数，高于各部门合计的平均。需要返回部门编码、请假天数。
expect_sql: SELECT d.dept_code, SUM(l.leave_days) AS leave_days FROM company.att_leave l JOIN company.hr_employee e ON e.id = l.emp_id JOIN company.org_department d ON d.id = e.dept_id JOIN company.att_leave_type t ON t.id = l.leave_type_id WHERE l.status = 'approved' AND t.is_paid = FALSE AND l.start_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND l.start_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY d.dept_code HAVING SUM(l.leave_days) > ( SELECT AVG(x.days) FROM ( SELECT SUM(l2.leave_days) AS days FROM company.att_leave l2 JOIN company.hr_employee e2 ON e2.id = l2.emp_id JOIN company.att_leave_type t2 ON t2.id = l2.leave_type_id WHERE l2.status = 'approved' AND t2.is_paid = FALSE AND l2.start_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND l2.start_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY e2.dept_id ) x ) ORDER BY leave_days DESC, d.dept_code

question: 工资期间所属年月在 2025 年、期间状态是已关账的工资，按员工把实发加总，高于自己部门同事平均实发的列出来。需要返回部门编码、工号、实发。
expect_sql: SELECT d.dept_code, e.emp_no, SUM(s.net_pay) AS net_pay FROM company.fin_salary_slip s JOIN company.fin_salary_period p ON p.id = s.period_id JOIN company.hr_employee e ON e.id = s.emp_id JOIN company.org_department d ON d.id = s.dept_id WHERE p.status = 'closed' AND p.year_month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND p.year_month < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY d.dept_code, d.id, e.emp_no HAVING SUM(s.net_pay) > ( SELECT AVG(x.emp_net) FROM ( SELECT SUM(s2.net_pay) AS emp_net FROM company.fin_salary_slip s2 JOIN company.fin_salary_period p2 ON p2.id = s2.period_id WHERE s2.dept_id = d.id AND p2.status = 'closed' AND p2.year_month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND p2.year_month < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s2.emp_id ) x ) ORDER BY net_pay DESC, e.emp_no

question: 活动花费状态是已付款或已通过、并且花费金额已经超过活动预算金额的，按部门把活动和金额列出来。需要返回部门编码、活动编码、预算金额、已花费。
expect_sql: SELECT d.dept_code, b.activity_code, b.budget_amount, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) AS spent FROM company.fin_activity_budget b JOIN company.org_department d ON d.id = b.dept_id LEFT JOIN company.fin_activity_expense e ON e.budget_id = b.id AND e.status IN ('paid', 'approved') GROUP BY d.dept_code, b.activity_code, b.budget_amount HAVING COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) > b.budget_amount ORDER BY spent DESC, b.activity_code

question: 项目状态是进行中的项目上发生过投诉，并且该客户有下单日期在 2025 年、订单状态是已签约、交付中或已关闭的订单，按客户统计投诉条数。需要返回客户编码、条数。
expect_sql: SELECT c.customer_code, COUNT(*)::bigint AS cnt FROM company.crm_complaint cp JOIN company.prj_project p ON p.id = cp.project_id JOIN company.crm_customer c ON c.id = cp.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'active' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company.sal_sales_order o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'draft') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' ) GROUP BY c.customer_code ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.customer_code
